NUTRITIONAL GUIDE
HALAAL
NUTRITIONAL GUIDE
ALLERGEN
GUIDE
At Debonairs Pizza, we’re serious about making good, quality, and oh-so-rhalising meals. That’s why we carefully prepare your food using the freshest ingredients. We’ve put together this nutritional analysis of our menu items so that you can be empowered to make informed decisions about your dietary needs. It’s a comprehensive analysis that has been calculated using leading databases such as the South African Food Composition Database (SAFOOD).

Please refer to the key on the right to help you navigate the nutritional information.

kJ = Kilojoules
g = Grams
mg = Milligrams

RINGA NATHI! LET'S TALK ABOUT ALLERGENS

All our meals are freshly prepared and with the utmost care, but we cannot guarantee that they are completely free of allergens. This is because in our kitchen, we share equipment and use different ingredients from various suppliers.
